text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Hey, hey, Trainer. Turbo's gotten 
pretty grown-up, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I've calmed down some, so I guess I can 
quietly slip into the hot springs now~"
choice_data_list: Hmm, I'm not so sure about that...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, why, why?! Turbo's even gotten 
really good at going into the gates now, 
too, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, the hot springs will be 
totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Hot springs! Hot springs!
choice_data_list: You're right. Well, shall we go?
Yeah. Shall we get going, then?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay-yay-yay!

Though I had been a little worried, she 
had definitely worked hard. We decided to 
set off on a hot spring trip as a reward.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that felt so good~! Hot springs 
really are the best...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta stay in until I'm totally drenched 
in sweat~. Phew~, Turbo pushed herself to 
the absolute limit~!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alright, next up is dinner in our room!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Umm, this dish and these vegetables, Turbo 
hates 'em, so give 'em to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But if we do that, we won't have 
enough side dishes, so~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, another plate of what Turbo 
likes, please!!

"Since it's a reward trip, selfishness is 
fully unlocked. Twin Turbo orders whatever 
she wants one after another. And then..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's play cards, cards! Then a 
pillow fight, then ping-pong, and after 
that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "A nighttime picnic!! Yeahhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's wrong? Turbo wants to walk 
around way, way more!
choice_data_list: My body really can't handle this...

text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo played around endlessly. On 
that day, the human body reached its 
limit.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm baaaack! Trainer, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
While Trainer was down for the count, 
Turbo went somewhere really cool!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
There was a place near the inn with lots 
of Umamusume. Umm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: An umamusume... rehabilitation center?
choice_data_list:
Ah, so it's a convalescent facility for 
Umamusume...

Ah, that's a convalescent facility for 
Umamusume, isn't it...

text_block_list.text:
Hearing that made me realize. Right, this 
is a hot spring resort in Fukushima...

Right nearby, there's a hot spring 
therapeutic facility for injured 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo chatted with those girls over there, 
and they praised Turbo a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Talking to Turbo always cheers me right 
up! Makes whatever I was worrying about 
seem so silly.

Twin Turbo was always bright and positive. 
The Umamusume undergoing medical treatment 
seemed to be cheered up after talking with 
her.

—Fukushima. In this land tied to her that 
treated her so well, maybe Twin Turbo was 
able to give back just a little.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And guess what! Turbo got asked! The girls 
at the center told me, "Come play again 
tomorrow and the day after!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Course I told 'em it's totally okay. Said 
they're gonna come over to play every day 
from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Whew, Trainer, hot springs really are 
amazing~ The water feels so good, and the 
food's delicious too."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer plays with me every day, and 
the other girls thank me too! That's 
why...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo has decided! I'm gonna live in this 
inn for a while!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Looking surprised won't stop me! Turbo has 
already made up her mind! This place is 
awesome, so I'm moving in!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I don't wanna! Does Trainer not wanna 
play with Turbo every day?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to stay like this forever! At 
least five or six more nights! And stay 
with Turbo from morning till night. Okay!?

Twin Turbo blurted out something 
outrageous. That just goes to show how 
much she's taken a liking to this place.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and Twin 
Turbo...
